manual._source: Monthly agency report (Meta Business Suite). Windsor.ai does not expose these Instagram metrics.

ig: Keep leaning into comment-to-engage prompts — three of the top five posts used one.
Prioritize follower growth: new followers have fallen four months running (1,013 → 549 → 268 → 203).
Give wedding content a fresh, story-driven angle — it has landed in the bottom five four months in a row.
Lead sales posts with feeling, not the offer — keep booking codes, but open with a short hook.
fb: Keep prioritizing video — it has out-reached photos every month tracked.
Treat September as a return to baseline after an outlier August (one video drove ~104K reach).
Add clickable website links to more posts — link clicks rebounded for the first time in three months.
Give direct-booking posts a feeling-first hook.
Keep reusing top Instagram copy on Facebook — the top two Facebook posts were Instagram top-five posts.
